meta.source: Telangana State GIS: HYDRAA water-body layer (tank survey number 'Base_Syno') matched to Bhunaksha_Cadastral layer 0 and Hydra_Folder/Fourth_Window layer 0 parcels, fetched Oct 2026
meta.match_rule: parcel number equals the tank's survey number (sub-survey 81/1 counts as 81) AND the parcel lies within 150 m of the tank outline; village names are not used
meta.note: A parcel carrying a tank's survey number is not the legal Full Tank Level and says nothing about encroachment. Parcels shown are survey-record polygons, not owner or title information.
